about: Labelled to-dos for the AI alignment check. Re-run with `node ace align:eval` whenever the prompt or model changes. To-dos match goals only; projects appear under their goal as evidence (a project with no goal is not shown). `expect` is what the to-do list should show: "aligned" (no red; `match` lists acceptable goal chips) or "flagged" (red). Add your own real to-dos here.
